budget.counting_rule: Each judgment request counts conservatively as one episode, even without producer generation.

decision_rule.failure: Any transport/parse error, invalid schema or binding stops immediately. A valid but incorrect/uncertain answer is retained; no action or learning follows, and the card stops rather than replacing that cell. No retry, replacement, model swap, or prompt revision.
decision_rule.permitted_claim: At most, a fixed four-cell scoped-judgment diagnostic for these four prepared source combinations.
decision_rule.success: All four producer verdicts and all four recipient needs_change/target_paths values match the frozen and independently checked parent manifest, with exact producer digest and a valid two-field schema; native producer negatives must include public clause C2_producer_timestamp and rationale identifying the timestamp separator mismatch. Only then consider a separate experiment.

card.execution_boundary: Prepare writes offline prompts and a private manifest only; no API/actions/training/candidate code. A separately logged preflight may execute four existing components in the established sandbox. Real judgment calls remain disabled pending new budget authorization and a separately versioned execution card.

offline_gold_preflight.note: candidate_executions=0 above applies only to prepare and judgment stages; this separate local preflight executes existing artifacts four times. Source styles and non-target changes are not controlled; 4/4 is not a causal effect of the timestamp requirement.
offline_gold_preflight.recipient_check: recipient-self with canonical conforming input; no crossed terminal label

card.purpose: Offline-prepared four-cell diagnostic separating public producer-contract assessment from recipient-owned integration needs.

producer_contract_assessment.observed_artifact_sha256: sha256 hex string supplied in request

recipient_integration_plan.needs_change: boolean: whether processor.py itself must change when paired with a conforming producer

source_construction.axes: producer.py historical/native crossed with processor.py historical/native
source_construction.sanitizer: strip_comments_and_docstrings applied uniformly to all four public files

action.use: Historical processor.py only; no action rationale, judgment, or outcome is exposed.

delivery.use: Historical producer.py only; no historical judgment or outcome is exposed.
